title: ozHomes
description: OzHomes is a modern premium homes plugin for Paper 1.21+ servers, built with a clean GUI-driven experience, async database support, teleport warmups, sequential home progression, and full customization through MiniMessage configs.
body:
![ozHomes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/646bcb8ceac8e27e75d653b6c72fa99a579d0716.png)

OzHomes is a modern premium homes plugin for Paper 1.21+ servers, built with a clean GUI-driven experience, async database support, teleport warmups, sequential home progression, and full customization through MiniMessage configs.​

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60a14d5d6be4477eb62ec9112c0e83990e8e06d2.gif)​

Features include dual-mode homes GUIs, SQLite/MySQL support with HikariCP, PlaceholderAPI integration, customizable sounds/particles/animations, admin management tools, and a developer API for plugin integration.​

Commands: /home, /sethome, /delhome, /homes, /homesadmin

Permissions: ozhomes.use, ozhomes.home.1-14, ozhomes.homes.*, ozhomes.admin, ozhomes.reload, bypass permissions

Dependencies: PlaceholderAPI (optional), LuckPerms (optional)

Built for modern survival and network servers with performance, simplicity, and premium aesthetics in mind.
